$comment: types/database.ts is generated from the live schema and is authoritative for tables, columns,
types, nullability, defaults, enums, functions and foreign keys. It carries NOTHING about
unique constraints, check constraints, partial indexes or RLS policies — Postgres has them,
the generated types don't. That is what this file supplies.
So: never edit column facts here (the generator ignores them). Do update this file in the same
commit as any migration that adds or changes a constraint, index or policy. The generator warns
loudly and marks the HTML when a table in types/database.ts has no entry here.

recipes.purpose: One recipe. The only table with no foreign key — everything else hangs off it.
indexes: recipes_published_created_at_idx on (published, created_at desc) — serves the public list: filter to published, newest first
notes: updated_at is maintained by a trigger, not by the app.
slug is derived from the title and never editable — a rename changes a live URL.

recipe_steps.purpose: Ordered instructions for one recipe. Rewritten wholesale by save_recipe() on every save.
constraints: foreign key (recipe_id) references recipes (id) on delete cascade
notes: image_path is unused — no Storage bucket exists. See docs/image-storage.md.

recipe_ingredients.purpose: Ordered ingredients for one recipe. Rewritten wholesale by save_recipe() on every save.
constraints: foreign key (recipe_id) references recipes (id) on delete cascade
notes: group_label existed briefly and was removed in c2c231d (2026-08-01) — ingredient grouping is not a feature.

recipe_images.purpose: Gallery images for one recipe. Nothing writes this table yet — no Storage bucket exists.
constraints: foreign key (recipe_id) references recipes (id) on delete cascade
indexes: recipe_images_one_primary_idx — unique on (recipe_id) where is_primary: unlimited images per recipe, at most one primary
notes: The ONLY table save_recipe() does not write. Steps and ingredients are replaced as a whole set, so their positions never collide; images would be patched row by row, and unique (recipe_id, sort_order) is not deferrable. See issue 1 in docs/known-issues.md.
storage_path holds a path inside a bucket, not a URL.
on delete cascade removes these rows but NOT the files they name.

rls.summary: Enabled on all four tables. Two roles: visitor (anon) and admin (authenticated) — every logged-in account is an admin. Full model: docs/permission-model.md.
grants: grant select on <all four> to anon, authenticated
grant insert, update, delete on <all four> to authenticated

save_recipe.summary: The only write path for a recipe and its children.
save_recipe.security: security invoker · set search_path = '' · execute revoked from public and anon, granted to authenticated
notes: Exists because Supabase JS sends every statement as its own transaction, so a delete-then-insert of children could leave a recipe with no steps.
Writes recipe_steps and recipe_ingredients as whole sets, taking position from array order. Does not touch recipe_images.
Extend it by reading another key off the payload, never by adding parameters.
